integrity: An unrestricted projective incidence proof with a separate finite over-approximation checker; claim and limits described in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: The basket (1,10,4) is excluded for three smooth conics plus three lines over C with only A1, A3, D4 singularities. The basket (0,9,5) is only a necessary condition for near freeness, not an existence result. The auxiliary finite checker does not establish realizability or replace the geometric proof. No independent audit or external validation has occurred. Earlier unindexed equivalent incidence arguments remain a priority risk.
title: Excluding the ten-tacnode basket for three conics and three lines
